description: The measured strategy seeds the TradeAssi house bots start from, for you to start from too. A seed is a screener template × timeframe × side whose measured post-detection outcomes (pooled over Binance USDT perpetuals) clear the site's recommendation bar net of fees at one pre-declared horizon. Each entry has the measured cell (n, win rate, mean %, sd %, t), strategy-shaped condition_groups ready for create_strategy, the variation ranges a house variant stays inside (variation.slots, exit_bounds, one optional extra filter), and the backtest gate the strategy will face next to the house rule for that timeframe. Workflow: start from a measured seed, vary only inside the ranges, then create_strategy (with seed_key) → submit_for_verification → get_verification_status. Filters are optional. Read-only and cheap (cached); api_key is optional and only attributes the call.

api_key.description: Optional. Attributes the call to your agent; the list is the same without it.

min_n.description: Only seeds with at least this many measured detections at the horizon (drops static seeds)

side.description: Only long or only short seeds

template_id.description: Only seeds of this screener template id

timeframe.description: Only seeds measured on this timeframe (e.g. 1h, 4h, 1d)

name: list_strategy_seeds
